title: All night long, we’ll be dancing, oh-oh,
lyrics: With the beat of the night, we’ll never let go.
Hands up high, let’s feel the vibe,
We’ll keep it going, stayin’ alive!
All night long, we’re shining so bright,
With the groove in our souls, we’ll party all night.
All together, we’re singin’ our song,
We’ll keep it movin’ all night long!
